title: The River Answered Twice
scene: A reed-and-clay recording station at the Braided Reach, visited after the Harvest

the expected final pulse is withheld

actors.first_reading: The support may be responding to its own load
actors.caution: Measurement does not cover every experience

actors.first_reading: Close the narrow route; preserve the wide path
actors.caution: Safety need not wait for agreement

actors.first_reading: For one instant I knew the bend without its water
actors.caution: A report is not a direct command from Alchul

opening: The clay bank answers the Listener's contact foot a little late. The low reed stave gives a second, contrary reply.
The Turner hears ordinary wood changing under a load. The Listener hears a river pulse moving through wet sediment.
A Keeper blocks the narrow route but keeps the broad path open. No one has to agree in order to help.
From the Harvest, a witness carries an account of this same bend in another condition. It is placed beside the test, not inside it.

trials.title: Redirect the water
trials.intent: Check whether the bank pulse tracks changed water flow
trials.conclusion: The pulse follows the water intervention. The Listener's explanation gains support, but the test can be repeated elsewhere.

trials.title: Change the support load
trials.intent: Check whether the stave answers its own weight
trials.conclusion: The pulse follows the weighted reed. The Turner's explanation gains support; the Listener still felt a real change.

trials.title: Leave both sources and add interference
trials.intent: Expose how concurrent causes and noisy testimony can prevent a single answer
trials.conclusion: Both readings survive. The narrow route stays closed, the new test is kept, and no account is erased.

narrative_lenses.name: The Unclosed Account
narrative_lenses.description: Altered-state testimony remains meaningful without becoming a physical measurement

ending_principle: A community learns to act together without pretending every witness is certain.
governance: This scene proposes a way of keeping disagreement, not a universal legal system, caste or religion.
biological_scope: The inhabitants are left offscreen; T16 E1-E3 are morphology hypotheses, not jobs or definitive species.
contact_scope: Alchul is separately real in fictional canon; this episode does not reveal Alchul's form, intention or exact involvement.
evidence_scope: T17 physical readings are normalized illustrative model values and never proofs of ancient physics.
